text:
Igor Petrov: Hey @Nina, we received 4 DOA GPUs from the last batch. Need to coordinate RMA + replacements ASAP, our dedicated pool is degraded.
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): Sorry to hear that, Igor. Can you confirm serials and whether you want air expedite or split-sea replacement? We can start claim RMA-89321 today.
Igor Petrov: Serial list below. Prefer partial air for critical nodes (4 units), rest sea. Also need provisional ETA for customs clearance — we’re trying to avoid further capacity impact.
Derrick Shaw: dropping serials here:
```
SN: GIGA-RTX-0012345
SN: GIGA-RTX-0012346
SN: GIGA-RTX-0012347
SN: GIGA-RTX-0012348
SN: GIGA-RTX-0012349
SN: GIGA-RTX-0012350
```
Li Chen: noted. Cluster ops: two pods down, expecting spillover on inference jobs in us-west1 if not replaced within 72h. Can we get 2x hot spares from the pool? Maya O'Connor: We can reassign 1 spare but that still leaves a deficit. Need ETA on air vs sea to plan fallbacks.
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): For air (priority) we can ship 4 units same-day pickup, ETA 48-72h door-to-door to SFO (inc. customs). Cost: $11,500/unit air freight + expedited handling. Sea option: 10-14 days, $3,600/unit FOB + typical duties. Insurance claim note: declared value must match invoice to avoid hold.
Igor Petrov: Are there any customs HS code issues we should expect? Last time two units were held for additional documentation.
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): Use HS code 8473.30 (memory/processing units) and include commercial invoice + manufacturer certificate. Also suggest splitting into two AWBs to reduce single-ship hold risk: AWB AWB-5971023 (air, 4pcs) + AWB AWB-8974410 (sea, rest).
ShipBot: RMA ticket RMA-89321 created and linked to AWB AWB-5971023. ETA (est): 2024-12-05T14:00Z for air pickup.
Li Chen: Please attach packing manifest and declared values. We need separate insurance coverage for air shipments — no mixing with sea policy.
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): attaching manifest snippet:
```
AWB: AWB-5971023
Type: AIR_EXPRESS
Pieces: 4
Items:
 - GIGA-RTX-0012345 : declared USD 13,000
 - GIGA-RTX-0012346 : declared USD 13,000
 - GIGA-RTX-0012347 : declared USD 13,000
 - GIGA-RTX-0012348 : declared USD 13,000
```
Maya O'Connor: Confirmed. Procurement: can we absorb air freight cost under emergency ops budget? Igor?
Igor Petrov: We have a small cap in emergency freight. Confirming with finance now — if not, please proceed and we’ll reconcile with vendor credit or PO adjustment.
Derrick Shaw: Quick ask: will vendor provide replacement serials or refurbished units? We prefer new units for Dedicated nodes.
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): We can supply new units for the air expedited replacements. For sea replacements we may provide refurbished unless you specify otherwise (lead time and price differ).
Li Chen: If sea units are refurbished, we need full test logs and burn-in report on arrival before we permit them into the fleet.
Igor Petrov: Understood. Nina, please start air pickup and confirm carrier & AWB number. Also open insurance valuation claim on any DOA units still in vendor RMA center.
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): Carrier: FalconAir Cargo. AWB for air created: AWB-5971023. Insurance filed under policy #INS-4421 with declared totals. RMA center will sign for DOAs and start root-cause soak tests.
ShipBot: Update: AWB-5971023 picked up by FalconAir at 2024-12-03T09:12Z. Current status: In-transit -> Customs SFO.
Maya O'Connor: Thanks. Ops will stage two hot spares for swap, hope the replacements clear customs.
Igor Petrov: One more: vendor credit for DOA units — what's the timeline for refund vs credit note? We need to adjust our accounting (capex vs replacement SLA).
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): Standard: credit note issued once RMA validated (5-7 business days). If inspection shows DOA verified we can issue immediate provisional credit to expedite reconciliation.
Derrick Shaw: please tag when provisional credit is issued so finance can process.
Li Chen: Also flag: if customs requests additional paperwork we'll need the manufacturer cert with serials mapped — vendor to supply within 8h of request.
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): Will do. I'll upload manufacturer certificate and burn-in logs for sea replacements within business day.
Igor Petrov: Excellent. Action items recap:
 - Nina: start air pickup (AWB-5971023) + upload manifest, manufacturer certs, insurance claim.
 - Nina: open provisional credit for RMA-89321 if DOA confirmed.
 - Li/Maya: stage hot spares and coordinate swaps in us-west1.
 - Derrick: validate serials on arrival and run burn-in.
 - Igor: confirm budget for air freight and ping finance.
Nina Alvarez (GigaSupply): All set, I'll post docs to the RMA ticket and ping here when insurance/credit done. :thumbsup:
ShipBot: RMA-89321 status -> PICKED_UP_BY_CARRIER
